services.name: Theatre Tours
services.desc: Many young performers in DeKalb County get their first taste of theatre through the DeKalb Children’s Community Theatre’s Imagination Summer Camp. A longtime summer tradition, the program gives campers the opportunity to explore acting, music, dance, and a variety of technical theatre skills in a supportive and creative environment. Whether participants are stepping on stage for the first time or preparing to perform a full musical in just two weeks, the camp is designed to help students grow their confidence and abilities.
